_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: Before I formed you in the womb I knew you.
In you, O Lord, we take refuge.
Do not be afraid, for I am with you to deliver you.
In you, O Lord, we take refuge.
And now faith, hope, and love abide; the greatest of these is love.
Come, let us worship. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Hear the word spoken to a young and frightened prophet: I knew you before you were.
In you, O Lord, we take refuge.
Do not say you are too young, too small, too unready; I will put my words in your mouth.
In you, O Lord, we take refuge.
The truth is not always welcome; even hometowns turn on the ones who tell it.
In you, O Lord, we take refuge.
But love bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
In you, O Lord, we take refuge; love never ends!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: Before you were formed, God knew you and called you.
In you, O Lord, we take refuge.
Do not be afraid; God puts his words in your mouth.
In you, O Lord, we take refuge.
Love bears, believes, hopes, endures; love never ends.
In you, O Lord, we take refuge. Amen.
